summary.text: Ricki Ruiz is a Democratic state representative from Oregon House District 50 who has served since January 11, 2021, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Ricki Ruiz was born in Portland, Oregon, and earned a bachelor's degree in social entrepreneurship from Warner Pacific University in 2016.
His career experience includes working in the government sector.
He succeeded Carla Piluso in the Oregon House.
